list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them

sources.advice: Our own advice, read from the official description — not yet checked in the game
sources.exophase: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5), exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/ — official names, descriptions and grades
sources.psnprofiles: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies, psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi — PSN progress targets (counts)

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Work the Roadmap tab in order — story first, then strangers and collectibles, and save the 100% clean-up for last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Nothing to plan; just play.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Keep playing the main story; it pops at the end of the chapter.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Keep playing the main story; it pops at the end of the chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Keep playing the main story; it pops at the end of the chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Keep playing the main story; it pops at the end of the chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the final mission. Finish the story and it pops. Because it is the last story beat, do any mission-tied trophies you still need before the finale — the Missables tab flags them.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run. Play through the story; the mission appears as you progress.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission The Cartel Heist. Play through the story; the mission appears as you progress.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play. Play through the story; the mission appears as you progress.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners. Play through the story; the mission appears as you progress.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission VCIA Takedown. Play through the story; the mission appears as you progress.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Operation Savage Glory. Play through the story; the mission appears as you progress.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The 100% trophy. The in-game checklist tracks it — story, strangers, collectibles, activities and the rest all count. Treat the Roadmap tab as the plan: finish the story, then work the stages in order and use the tracker to see what is left. Our own reading of the official description — the exact 100% checklist lives in the game's stats screen, which we have not checked yet.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: 250 stunts. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses and airtime moments the game counts as you drive and ride around Leonida. Don't grind them: they build up naturally across the whole game, so chase them whenever you are travelling and check the count in the stats screen.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once — the game counts each type the first time you try it. Work through what the game offers as activities — races, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting — and watch the tracker: a type stops counting once it is done. The official list does not name the types, so we have not checked the full list in the game yet.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting ranges across Leonida and work through their challenges; gold needs a clean, fast run, so learn a range's targets with a practice pass first, then go for gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Drone races are timed; learn each course's line before racing it flat out, and a win at every location pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races count once each — winning the same race twice does not add to the total — so work through the race list and keep a note of which ones you have won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: out-fish Cal and the trophy is yours. Fish calmly and steadily rather than rushing the reel — our own advice from the description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, pick a game and play it to the end. Any arcade game counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Andy is one of the contacts with a mission strand: play his missions in order and the final one pops this trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Kenton is one of the contacts with a mission strand: play his missions in order and the final one pops this trophy.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Billy is one of the contacts with a mission strand: play his missions in order and the final one pops this trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore the state — keep an eye out for their markers while travelling, and finish a strand to the end before moving on.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Randy is one of the contacts with a mission strand: play his missions in order and the final one pops this trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone is one of the contacts with a mission strand: play his missions in order and the final one pops this trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet places in the world; visit each and meditate. Work through them while exploring so you don't have to backtrack at the end.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at a specific animal — follow his missions and take the shot when the hunt comes. Our own advice from the description; the animal's location is not pinned down in the official list.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a set is complete when you hold all of its cards. Collect as you explore and keep sets together — three finished sets pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the photo-sharing spot activity: open it at 100 different places across the state. Do it whenever you reach somewhere new rather than saving it for the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small goals the game tracks — stunts, driving, combat and more. They add up across everything you do; check the challenge list in the game to see which ones are close.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Flagged missable: it needs your partner with you, and partner moments may not come back — do it when the chance is there.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.note: Needs your partner beside you. Do it when the moment comes.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies with your partner and keep the heat off between them — plan the route first so you are not caught between shops. Flagged missable: it needs your partner and a clean run, so do it when the moment comes.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.note: Needs your partner and a clean run of three shops.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive counts the first time you get in it. Try everything you see — cars, bikes, boats, planes — and the total climbs.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus slows time: trigger it with a group of enemies in front of you and drop five before it ends. Pick a busy fight and line the shots up first.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. The description points at leaving the airport in a way the game did not schedule; a stolen plane is the obvious reading, but the official list does not say how. Flagged missable: it is tied to a one-off moment at the airport, so try it when you are there.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.note: Tied to a moment at the airport (VCIA).

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — the tank. Get into a Rhino tank, or face one, and survive the heat. The description is a joke, not an instruction: the trophy is about the Rhino, and the exact trigger is not pinned down in the official list — we have not checked it in the game.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses, no cameras spotting you. Scout the store first, then move when the coast is clear.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults are the big robberies — plan each one, then get clear afterwards. Five successful vault jobs pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, hit it, and get away clean.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. The map fills in as you travel; visit every named area of the state. Work through the map region by region so nothing is left at the end.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — all 9 gangs. Each gang runs illegal operations; hit one per gang. Keep a note of which gangs you have done.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail and take it in. A quiet one — do it whenever you are in Vice City.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description points at a showroom escape — drive out through the glass in style. Flagged missable: it reads like a one-off story moment, so do it when it comes up rather than assuming you can come back to it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.note: Reads like a one-off story moment.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish a game — follow-through is the hint, so finish your throw properly.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it is tied to a partnership moment, and the official list does not say what to do. Flagged missable: do it when a partnership moment comes up; we have not checked the trigger in the game.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.note: Tied to a partnership moment; the trigger is not spelled out.

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The game tracks your choices — PSN counts them toward 500. Make choices as the story offers them; the total builds across the game. Flagged missable: some choices may lock others out, so think before you pick.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.note: Some choices may lock others out.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description points at succeeding on a second attempt — retry something and get it right the second time. Flagged missable: it is tied to a retry moment, so it may only come up once.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange in Leonida — a rare or random event. Keep playing and keep your eyes open; it finds you rather than the other way round. Flagged missable: rare events may not repeat, so don't ignore something odd when it happens.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.note: A rare event — don't ignore something odd.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, knock someone over with a melee attack from the vehicle. A slow drive-by past a pedestrian does it — pick a quiet street.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your contacts to launder them, and $250,000 laundered pops the trophy. It builds across the game — launder as you earn.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Money spent in any shop counts — clothes, weapons, food, cars. It adds up across the whole game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them. Garages are bought around Leonida; buy all eight. Save up and buy them as you find them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register vehicles you find — 10 registrations pop the trophy.
trophies.name: On the Spot
